summary: feat(settings): derive page title from h1 and focus it in AppLayout
description:
Because:

* Most AppLayout pages pass no title, so the tab title stays "Mozilla accounts".
* Focus falls to body after a route change, so screen readers announce nothing.
* CI build-react failed on an exhaustive-deps warning in the title effect.

This commit:

* Derives the page title from the main h1, without .card-subheader text.
* Focuses the main h1 after mount and loading, unless something has focus.
* Gives the title effect the deps [children, l10n].
* Adds AppLayout tests and updates Signin expectations and snapshots.

Closes FXA-6803
